seny: sanity checks for differential expression in noisy data

Source: R/seny-package.R
seny-package.Rd

For every cluster-by-contrast comparison in a multi-sample single-cell dataset, seny decides whether a pseudobulk differential expression test is Adequate, Underpowered, Caution or Invalid, and explains why. The diagnostics are analytic and run on the user's own data: design validity and confounding (layer 1), pseudobulk quality (layer 2), and variance structure plus sensitivity (layer 4), the last giving a per-gene minimum detectable effect from a negative-binomial variance model. No per-dataset simulation.

Details

The name is a backronym – Sanity checks for differential gene Expression in NoisY data – and also the Catalan word for common sense.

The main entry point is assessAll(), which chains pbSetup(), assessDesign(), assessPseudobulk(), estimateVariance(), estimateSensitivity() and callComparisons().
